about: The Hart County Recreation Department strives to provide the citizens of Hart County with wholesome, quality leisure activities and facilities for all segments of the population. The department continues to plan future programs and develop facilities that enhance quality of life in Hart County.
Park facilities are open to the public and may be available to rent for certain functions. Contact the Recreation Department for more information.
facilities: Two large picnic shelters with attached playgrounds
